title: Pablo Amaringo on flying saucers as spirit-world vehicles

tellings.quote: vehicles for entering and leaving the spirit world
matter-of-factly, he he said, "Oh, well, those are vehicles for entering and leaving the spirit world."
tellings.difference: Dates it loosely to the 1990s-2000s rather than 2005, and credits the books Supernatural and Visionary.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Hancock relaying Amaringo's statement that flying saucers are vehicles for entering and leaving the spirit world.

as_told.title: Pablo Amaringo's flying saucers as vehicles for the spirit world

plain: Graham Hancock, a writer on lost ancient civilizations, says that a Peruvian painter from the Amazon named Pablo Amaringo once told him, matter-of-factly, that the flying saucers in his paintings were "vehicles for entering and leaving the spirit world." Hancock tells this in two podcast interviews and links it to his book Supernatural, and in one telling he places it more loosely in the 1990s or 2000s rather than around 2005. He shares it because it suggests UFOs might belong to visionary or spirit experience rather than outer space.
